About Medical Unit-II

Patient care, clinical training and academic medicine.

Medical Unit-II serves as a clinical and teaching unit of GMC Teaching Hospital Sukkur, supporting patient care, postgraduate training, ward-based learning and modern internal medicine practice.

Head of Department · Medical Unit-II
Head of Department

Professor Dr. Saleh Muhammad Channa

MBBS, RMP, FCPS, FRCP
Consultant Physician in Internal Medicine · HOD, Medical Unit-II · Principal, GMC Sukkur

Professor Dr. Saleh Muhammad Channa is a highly experienced Consultant Physician in Internal Medicine and the Head of Medical Unit-II at GMC Teaching Hospital Sukkur. Over the course of his distinguished clinical career, he has treated thousands of patients and performed thousands of endoscopic procedures within Medical Unit-II, bringing extensive experience to the diagnosis and management of complex medical and gastrointestinal conditions.

Known for his visionary leadership, sound clinical judgment, and commitment to academic excellence, he has played a central role in strengthening Medical Unit-II as a centre for patient care, postgraduate training, and clinical learning. He is widely respected and appreciated by postgraduate trainees and medical students for his approachable teaching style, mentorship, and dedication to medical education.

Alongside his responsibilities as Head of Medical Unit-II, he is currently serving as Principal of GMC Sukkur, combining institutional leadership with continued clinical, academic, and teaching service.
